# llull features

<!-- Generated by `npm run features` from the command registry (listCommands, default plugins). Do not edit by hand:
     npm run check fails when this file is stale. -->

742 commands in 27 toolsets. Every command is one UI action and one `llull` CLI tool (`llull describe <name>` prints its parameters). Flags: **read-only** never changes the document; **kernel** needs the geometry kernel (exact B-rep with the native OCCT kernel). Host exchange tools (STEP/DWG/code import-export, FE solve) are listed by `llull list exchange`.
